description: Turns a pending suggested action from retro.board.insights.list into a real action item on the board and marks the suggestion accepted, keeping the wording and the link to its cluster. Requires mcp:write scope.

assign_to.description: User ID to assign the action item to — call retro.team.members.list to get it — or "me" to assign to the current user.

board_id.description: The ID of the board the suggestion belongs to.

suggested_action_id.description: The ID of the suggested action to promote, from suggested_actions in retro.board.insights.list. Only suggestions with status "pending" can be promoted.

name: retro.board.suggested_actions.promote
title: Promote Suggested Action Tool
